items.docs: Submit a document for parsing using a JSON request body. Accepts either a file_id referencing a previously uploaded file or a source_url to fetch the document from. Exactly one of file_id or source_url must be provided. The tier parameter determines the parsing mode. Jobs are processed asynchronously and results are retrieved via the job status endpoint.

info.name: Parse a document via file upload

items.docs: Submit a document for parsing using multipart file upload. The file is uploaded directly along with parsing configuration. The tier parameter determines the parsing mode. Jobs are processed asynchronously and results are retrieved via the job status endpoint.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of jobs to return.

params.name: offset
params.description: Number of jobs to skip for pagination.

items.docs: Retrieve a list of parse jobs for the authenticated project. Supports optional filtering and pagination to narrow down results.

params.name: jobId
params.description: Unique identifier of the parse job.

params.name: expand
params.description: Comma-separated list of result fields to include in the response. Controls whether text, markdown, structured JSON, or metadata is returned with the job status.

items.docs: Retrieve the status and optionally the results of a parse job. Use the expand parameter to control what parsed content is returned, including text, markdown, structured JSON, or metadata. Poll this endpoint to check job completion status.

params.name: jobId
params.description: Unique identifier of the parse job.

items.docs: Retrieve the full parsed result of a completed parse job. Returns the extracted content in the requested format. The job must be in a completed state for results to be available.
